[[File:Faarl.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The warlord Faarl carried a powerstaff.]]
A '''powerstaff''' was a defensive weapon employed by [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]]. [[Iggjel]] and his [[Iggjel's friend|friend]] each carried a powerstaff during their expedition to [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]].
